title: Revamp OS — Intake → Recall Job History → Approve → Commit

sections.label: 1 · INTAKE
sections.note: Emails, quote requests and work orders all land in one place and are read into a single job shape — client, address, scope, urgency. Nothing sits in an inbox waiting to be re-read.

sections.label: 2 · RECALL
sections.note: The part a CRM cannot do: search old jobs, notes and work logs from a messy clue. "That render job in Palm Beach, maybe 2023, the one with the tricky access" is enough to find the file, the photos and what was charged.

sections.label: 3 · PREPARE
sections.note: A site pack is drafted before the visit — what was quoted last time, what went wrong, materials used, access notes. The pre-visit prep that normally happens in your head, written down.

sections.label: 4 · APPROVE
sections.note: Nothing is sent, changed or deleted without a yes. The draft goes out for review with the reasoning attached, and the workflow waits. This gate is the difference between a useful assistant and one you stop trusting.

sections.label: 5 · COMMIT
sections.note: Only after approval: the quote lands in Xero, the jobs dashboard updates, and the work log is captured in a structured form so next year's pricing is based on what jobs actually cost rather than memory.

input_sample.subject: Re: render touch up + the balcony
input_sample.body: Hi mate, you did some render work for us a couple of years back — think it was the Palm Beach place with the awkward side access. Balcony's gone again in the same spot and mum wants the whole north wall done properly this time. Can you come have a look? No rush but before the wet season ideally.

output_sample.scope: Render repair — north wall full re-render, balcony crack rectification

history_recalled.matched_from_clue: "Palm Beach place with the awkward side access", ~2 years ago, render
history_recalled.job: RGC-2023-0184 · Nov 2023 · Render patch, south balcony
history_recalled.notes_found: Side access under 900mm — no wheelbarrow, all material hand-carried. Add 3hrs labour. Original render mix was oxide-tinted, batch noted in job file.

flagged_for_visit: Same location as 2023 patch — check for movement, not just surface cracking
Access constraint adds ~3hrs labour; price accordingly
Match existing oxide tint or quote full wall to avoid a visible join
site_pack.basis: 2023 rate + 18% materials movement + full wall vs patch + access loading

output_sample.pricing_intelligence: Render m² rate now backed by 6 completed jobs (2023-2026); access-constrained sites averaging +2.7hrs labour
